criterion_definitions.label: Potential to add mana on resolution
Costs do not move a card into or out of a library
Effect does not move a card into or out of a library
Disregard other applicable replacement effects in classification
Triggered candidate has no target requirement
Triggered candidate could add mana on resolution
Trigger tied to activated mana-ability activation/resolution or mana entering a pool

scope_notes: Exactly six Cards and seven local review subjects. Subject IDs are not canonical ability identities.
All criterion readings are authored interpretations of selected retained text, never established semantic facts.
All candidates require review, null human attestation, no canonical admission and blocked execution.
Card evidence observation 2026-08-02 and CR release 2026-09-25 are distinct time bindings; no current Oracle verification or official ruling is claimed.
No generic classifier, parser, model, fictional evaluator input or execution authority is supplied.
